d:
Waheguru… Waheguru… Find peace in the remembrance of Waheguru with Waheguru Simran, a soulful devotional song sung by Rabica Wadhawan, with music by Inderjeet Singh and composition by Jaidev Kumar.
A heartfelt prayer that brings calm to the mind and devotion to the soul. Close your eyes, listen with love and let the simran fill your heart
Write “Waheguru” in the comments
Song Credits
Track: Waheguru Simran
Singer: Rabica Wadhawan
Music: Inderjeet Singh
Composer: Jaidev Kumar
